# Smoky Mountain CPAs

> A two CPA firm in Knoxville, Tennessee, serving East Tennessee and small businesses nationwide. Monthly bookkeeping reconciled and reviewed by a licensed CPA, business and personal tax returns prepared from those same books, and an optional Profit First cash system. Most firms meet your taxes in April. We watch them all year.

## Start here: book a free 30 minute call
- Book a call: https://calendly.com/smokymountaincpas/30-min-discovery-call (free 30 minute discovery call)
- Existing clients: https://calendly.com/smokymountaincpas/client-call
- Rather be contacted? https://smokymtncpas.com/book/#reach-out
- A licensed CPA picks up. You will know on that call whether we are the right fit.
- Email: brooks@smokymountaincpas.com

## What we do
- Monthly bookkeeping: every transaction categorized, every account reconciled to its bank statement, reviewed by a licensed CPA before delivery.
- Monthly financial statements plus a plain English explanation of what changed and why.
- Business and personal tax returns, prepared and filed from the same books we keep monthly.
- QuickBooks cleanup and catch up for books that are behind, duplicated or unreconciled.
- An optional Profit First cash system (pay yourself first): income is split into set percentages the moment it lands, so profit, owner pay and taxes are set aside before spending.
- We do not provide audit or attest services.

## Who we serve
- Shopify and ecommerce sellers (payout reconciliation, multi channel sales, marketplace sales tax)
- Retail, boutique and jewelry stores (inventory aware books, vendor and AP hygiene)
- Contractors and trades (job cost visibility, owner draws)
- Real estate investors (books tracked per property, so you know which doors make money)
- Short term rental and cabin owners in Gatlinburg, Pigeon Forge and Sevierville (per cabin books, Airbnb payouts, Sevier County lodging tax)

## Where we work
Based in Knoxville, TN. Serving Knoxville, Farragut, Maryville, Oak Ridge, Sevierville, Gatlinburg, Pigeon Forge, Alcoa, Lenoir City, Clinton, Seymour and all of East Tennessee. Remote friendly nationwide.

## Pricing
- One flat monthly fee, quoted after we look at your actual books, not sold from a fixed price list. The first step is the free 30 minute call.
- Monthly service includes clean, CPA reviewed books, monthly financial statements, the business tax return and one owner's personal return, prepared and filed from those same books.
- The Profit First cash system is an optional add on, quoted separately.
- Every return we file includes $1 Million Tax Audit Defense: audit and IRS or state notice representation, plus identity theft restoration, at no extra cost.
- 30 day money back guarantee on monthly service.

## The people
Brooks McLean, CPA (founder, Certified Profit First Professional) and Caroline McLean, CPA (partner). Both licensed and Big Four trained (KPMG). The client roster is capped on purpose so a CPA answers your questions directly.
